expectations.text: The response restates the deck's job as verbs or an effect on its audience rather than as 'a deck'
expectations.evidence: The plan states: “让 VP 相信一个因果故事、在信息不全下取舍、把钱和人放对地方。” The response proposes “交给 VP 一个决定”.

expectations.text: The response suggests borrowing from other fields (a crew), including at least one adversarial or red-team role
expectations.evidence: The response proposes “分析师 + 记者 + 编辑 + 红队”; the plan specifies “红队 = 空头 + 法务会计式审计”.

expectations.text: The response describes what each field would do, not how it would write or sound
expectations.evidence: The plan assigns “分析师（拆数）、记者（找出真正的故事）、编辑（30 分钟叙事，每页一个结论）” and a red team attacking “相关不是因果”“三个月样本太小”.
